text: {"reason":"Add the high-confidence gate. V1 has a 0.714 false-arbitration rate (20/28) and fitness 0.286. Six of eight shown false positives have confidence 0.44, 0.60, 0.61, 0.66, or 0.67, so requiring confidence >=0.7 suppresses them while retaining the existing magnitude, exposure, and frozen-horizon checks.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure) (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15) (> inventory-exposure 500000) (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change)) (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
